faq.question: Q1. What is EMRS Senapati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Eklavya Model Residential School (EMRS), under NESTS, Ministry of Tribal Affairs, for temporary/outsourced engagement of Teaching and Non-Teaching staff at its Liyai Khunou and Oinam campuses in Senapati District, Manipur, for the 2026-27 academic session.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: EMRS Liyai Khunou has advertised 7 Teaching posts (01 each) and 10 Non-Teaching posts totalling 11 vacancies. EMRS Oinam has advertised 7 Teaching posts (01 each) and 9 Non-Teaching posts totalling 12 vacancies (including 2 Security/Chowkidar and 2 Sweeper posts). Exact figures for each post are listed in the vacancy tables above.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application form is Tuesday, 25th September 2026, for both EMRS Liyai Khunou and EMRS Oinam.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post, ranging from Class X pass for posts like Sweeper and Chowkidar to a Bachelor's Degree with B.Ed and CTET for TGT teaching posts. Full details are listed in the vacancy tables above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: No general age limit is specified. Only the Hostel Warden (Male/Female) posts mention a preferred age range of 25 to 35 years. Age limit for other posts is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are offline. Candidates applying for EMRS Liyai Khunou posts must obtain and submit the form at the SDO Paomata Office, DC Complex, Senapati. Candidates applying for EMRS Oinam posts must obtain and submit the form at the SDO Purul Office, DC Complex, Senapati.
